title: Community-Event Participation
dataSources: Volunteer shifts (`volunteer:shift`), donations (`donation:gift`), community events (`community:event`), mutual-aid requests (`mutualaid:request`), impact metrics (`impact:metric`).
app: Volunteering and community telemetry — volunteer-hours trackers, donation receipts, mutual-aid request boards, and community-event calendars — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=community:event
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as events, dc(event_type) as types by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts the community events you take part in each month and how varied they are.
value: Steady, varied participation is a sign of a healthy connection to where you live.
implementation: Ingest community events into `index=personal`; count participation per month.
visualization: Column chart of monthly community-event participation.
grandmaExplanation: It counts how many local events you join each month, showing how connected you are to your community.
